quest.title: Tatara Tales: Final Preparations
quest.description: Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ha, magnificent! The tests went very smoothly indeed. The onikabuto have been completely purified!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, let's...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: All we need to do now is to plan our route inside, and we can begin in earnest. However, we must avoid those Fatui... it seems that we'll have to take the long way.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: This thing is rather bulky, so it would be best for us to ensure that there are smooth paths for us to take as we move it inside.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: As such, I'd like you to re-enter the Mikage Furnace to investigate. If you encounter any broken paths, please help to restore them a little.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I have yet to decide our route, but having more roads open to us could not hurt, surely.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm no expert in fixing roads, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: You don't have to restore them to... well, perfect reliability. Just place a layer of wooden planks down so that we can move this device across.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ah, you can just grab the wooden planks from nearby. I'll remain here and try to make our machine as reliable as it can possibly be.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Alright, then. Have you checked our roads?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're as smooth as can be now.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Alright. Th—Then let us set off after a brief wait...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey. Are you...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I... I'm thinking! I'm thinking of all the things that could possibly happen, you understand?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: For example, what we'll do if those masked lunatics have already extracted the core when we enter.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: They might shove it into some Ruin Guard, causing it to go berserk and send us all flying.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Or maybe, some sort of elemental creature might emerge as we are purifying the Mikage Furnace, and might devour the core in a single bite.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: And in the worst case scenario, that legendary serpent might use this opportunity to resurrect itself. Then we'd be doomed! It'd be game over! Game over!

choices.text: Get a hold of yourself, Xavier...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ah! Um, sorry, I... My old habits are acting up again. I always envisage the worst case scenarios...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I'll make some plans, and once the time comes, let us go and put an end to this.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Please go well, please go well, please go well...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: These Onikabuto should do. Thank you! I shall begin tests immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Let's hope that everything goes smoothly. The sooner we settle this affair, the better. Who knows what we will happen if we delay further...
